text:
Sam: @here Kicking off investigation thread for sustained 5xx/timeouts hitting hosted-inference endpoint /v1/generate since ~07:12 UTC. Customers reporting high latency and intermittent 502/504s. opening notes: p95 latency jumped from 120ms -> 2.5s.
Alex: Copy. I've started a quick trace correlation for requests that hit the auth proxy. Early signal: auth proxy retries spiking + backend 502s.
Priya: Metrics alert fired for increased 5xx rate on gateway (ingress-gw) and a backlog metric on batcher service. Queue length up x6.
Dana: I'm on oncall. I'll take the live runbook and throttle rule checks. Can someone paste the curl repro?
Sam: Repro we used from support:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"rwx-large","prompt":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response pattern: fast 200s for most, but ~1 in 10 returns 502 or stalls ~30s then 504.
Jorge: From traces: a subset of requests routed to eu-west pool with KV-cache misses and large seqlen > 1024. Those triggered fallback path that calls dedicated runtime and sometimes times out on cold spinup.
Mei: A few enterprise customers (billing IDs A-102, B-233) reported billing errors concurrently — Lena, can you confirm if billing service had errors?
Lena: Billing showing transient 500s from authz microservice around same window due to token refresh failures with our KMS. Correlated but not identical cohort.
Priya: Hypothesis: auth proxy retry storms + KV-cache warmup causing executor saturation causing gateway 502/504. Need to validate if autoscaler failed to add capacity.
Alex: Checking autoscaler logs. Found rollout of a small autoscaler change at 06:55 UTC (canary) that increased scale cooldown to 90s. Deploy bot shows this deploy:
deploy-bot: canary/autoscaler-v2 deployed at 06:55 UTC to eu-west.
Alex: That cooldown makes scaling reactive instead of proactive. Under sudden fanout + cache misses, we hit saturation.
Dana: Mitigation proposal: 1) rollback the cooldown change in eu-west, 2) add a short-term increase to max replicas, 3) enable aggressive prefix caching for high-seqlen clients. I can run the rollback if we agree.
Sam: Also need customer comms template for support. Mei, can you draft an initial note saying we're investigating and working a mitigation?
Mei: Yep, will do. Keep wording: "intermittent 5xx/timeouts impacting some requests; working on mitigation; ETA TBD".
Jorge: Quick patch: pin routed requests with seqlen > 1024 to nodes with warm KV-cache (routing rule). I can push a routing override for 15m while autoscaler recovers. Requires reload of routing table — low-risk.
Alex: I'll prepare rollback PR for autoscaler cooldown and create a hotfix to reduce cooldown to 15s in eu-west.
Priya: On SRE side: I'll open temporary circuit-breaker on upstream runtime to fail-fast and give graceful fallback to smaller model variants to preserve availability. That reduces tail latency.
Lena: For billing errors, separate follow-up. We'll track but not blocking mitigation for 5xxs.
Sam: From support: customers want repro steps. Logging guidance for them: set X-Debug: headers and include request id when opening tickets. Add this snippet:
```
curl -H "X-Debug: 1" -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwx-large","prompt":"...","max_tokens":64}'
```
Alex: Quick data dump of failed req ids: req-3821, req-4299, req-4300. Priya can you pull traces for these?
Priya: Pulled them — all show auth proxy attempted 3 retries then backend 504. Logs show open connections exhausted on runtime side: "accept() resource temporarily unavailable".
Dana: I'm raising emergency scale to +40% for eu-west now. Will monitor for 2m.
Alex: Rollback PR open: autoscaler-cooldown-revert #2412. Hotfix scheduled and can be applied with 1-step deploy.
deploy-bot: Hotfix deploy started: autoscaler-cooldown-revert -> eu-west at 07:24 UTC.
metrics-bot: p95 latency (api): 2.4s -> 380ms after hotfix and scale-up. 5xx rate down 78% in 6 minutes.
Sam: Support update sent to impacted customers with ask to include request IDs.
Mei: Okay, action items post-incident: 1) revert cooldown change permanently until canary validation expanded, 2) add autoscaler e2e tests for sudden fanout + cache miss, 3) routing policy to prefer warmed nodes for large seqlen, 4) runbook update to include billing auth dependency checks, 5) customer comms template.
Jorge: I'll own routing policy (item 3). ETA EOD today for a conservative rollout.
Alex: I'll own autoscaler revert + e2e tests (items 1 & 2). ETA tomorrow morning.
Lena: I'll follow up on billing auth root cause and open a dedicated ticket for KMS token refresh flakiness.
Priya: SRE will add a guard to detect openfd/connect backlog and flip fast-fail threshold earlier. I'll PR that change and add test coverage. ETA 48h.
Dana: Oncall checklist: update runbook with these new mitigations and ensure the circuit-breaker defaults are set. I'll do that now and hand off to SRE for long-term.
Sam: Any outstanding customer repros to collect? If so please dump request_id + raw headers to support@redwood for tracking.
Mei: We'll schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC to review timeline, root cause, and communication. Invite list: all participants + legal for enterprise outreach.
Sam: Thanks all. Closing this thread — will update when postmortem doc ready. :white_check_mark:
